prompt: Complete AgendaSnapshot so neither the caller's list nor the Meeting objects inside it can be used to change the snapshot: copy the list AND every mutable Meeting, on the way in and on the way out.
explanation: Copying the list alone is not enough when its elements are mutable: the new list would still hold references to the very same Meeting objects, so whoever kept the old reference could still rewrite them. Copying each Meeting as well -- a deep copy -- gives the snapshot objects nobody else has a reference to. Returning fresh copies from meetings() closes the other direction, so a caller cannot reach in through the value you handed back.
hints: In the constructor, loop over the source list and add meeting.copy() -- not meeting -- to your own list.
meetings() must build a NEW ArrayList and fill it with fresh copies too, otherwise callers can edit your objects.
Treat a null source list as an empty snapshot so the field is never left null.
